description_en: Query hotline agent information and hotline skill groups
description_zh: 查询热线坐席信息与热线技能组
kebab_example: aliyun scsp get-agent-hotline --client-token example-string --instance-id example-string --account-name example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAgentHotline

parameters.help_en: Unique ID of the Customer request, used for idempotency validation; it can be generated using UUID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: AICCS instance ID, which can be found in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Agent account name (unique value), mapping between external account and XP account logon name
parameters.help_zh: 坐席账号名称(唯一值)，外部账号与XP账号登录名的映射
parameters.name: account_name
